name: Linux System Logs
summary: Open-source content pack for parsing, normalizing, and enriching Linux system logs.

description.@value: Stream containing all system events from Linux servers

source.@value:
pipeline "Linux Pipeline - System Fields"
stage 0 match all
rule "auth_log_extract_fields"
stage 1 match pass
rule "pam_extract_fields"
stage 2 match pass
rule "ssh_extract_fields"
rule "sudo_extract_fields"
rule "useradd_user_created"
rule "userdel_user_deleted"
rule "ssh_access_control"
rule "groupadd_group_created"
rule "usermod_user_id_changed"
rule "chfn_user_information_changed"
rule "groupdel_shadow_group_removed"
rule "passwd_password_changed"
rule "chsh_user_shell_changed"
rule "groupadd_shadow_group_added"
rule "groupadd_group_added"
rule "pam_auth_extract_fields"
stage 3 match pass
rule "ssh_vendor_credential_type"
rule "sudo_event_outcome"
rule "ssh_event_outcome"
rule "ssh_source_hostname"
end

query.query_string: (application_name:(useradd OR userdel OR groupadd OR groupdel OR usermod OR groupmod OR passwd OR gpasswd OR chsh OR chfn)) AND (_exists_:user_name)
(application_name:(useradd OR userdel OR groupadd OR groupdel OR usermod OR groupmod OR passwd OR gpasswd OR chsh OR chfn)) AND (_exists_:user_name)
(application_name:(useradd OR userdel OR groupadd OR groupdel OR usermod OR groupmod OR passwd OR gpasswd OR chsh OR chfn)) AND (_exists_:user_name)
(application_name:(useradd OR userdel OR groupadd OR groupdel OR usermod OR passwd OR gpasswd OR chsh OR chfn)) AND (_exists_:vendor_event_description)
(application_name:(useradd OR userdel OR groupadd OR groupdel OR usermod OR groupmod OR gpasswd OR chsh OR chfn)) OR ((application_name:(passwd OR chsh)) AND (vendor_pam_module:pam_unix))
